lessons.title: 一个事实只维护一个权威来源
lessons.summary: 指令、当前状态和长期经验分层维护，工具入口引用同一正文，避免复制后互相漂移。
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: 证据分层，不把旧状态当成今天
lessons.summary: 实现、检查通过、部署、启用和真实使用分别举证；记忆与当前证据冲突时先核实。
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: 失败与空结果必须区分
lessons.summary: 读取失败不能伪装成空值、默认内容或成功，恢复策略必须显式且可观测。
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: 测试资源隔离到实际身份
lessons.summary: 启动本地命令前确认实际数据库、账号、存储和 SDK 配置；测试不继承生产副作用。
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: 任务改动和共享资源分别隔离
lessons.summary: 保留无关改动，精确暂存；并行编辑用独立工作树，共享引用和环境单独协调。
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: 验证入口不能吞掉失败
lessons.summary: 必要检查失败、超时、命令缺失或配置缺失，都不能成为 PASS。
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: 按风险验证实际执行路径
lessons.summary: 静态检查和 mock 只证明对应层级；外部依赖、真实配置和用户交互需要适当的运行证据。
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: 配置名称不是发布目标身份
lessons.summary: 核对实际账号、项目、环境、候选修订和运行入口，不能从配置文件名或构建成功推断上线。
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: 数据修复先确认权威值与草稿
lessons.summary: 修改内容前找真实数据源，保留草稿与运营编辑，按字段和版本处理迁移。
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: 验证写入真正持久化
lessons.summary: 关键写入用独立连接或事务读回，并测试并发、失败和回滚，不只相信返回对象。
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: 权限与租户边界不能靠提权绕过
lessons.summary: 修访问规则而非默认提升角色，租户专属参数与公共能力分开维护。
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: 交互与链接检查最终呈现
lessons.summary: 控件应有真实语义和行为，验证最终页面目标以及键盘、鼠标和触屏关键交互。
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: 技术经验注明版本与失效条件
lessons.summary: 保留故障机制，复核具体版本命令与 workaround；旧经验不是永久真理。
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: 批量编辑保护不应变化的内容
lessons.summary: 用数值、结构和行为不变量检查大批量修改，差异先诊断归属再处理。
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: 时间测试固定时钟与业务时区
lessons.summary: 显式固定时钟与业务时区，覆盖跨日和夏令时等边界，避免靠等时间或跳过测试解决。
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: 缓存和后台进程也是构建输入
lessons.summary: 隔离任务的缓存、产物与 watcher，怀疑环境污染时先举证，不盲删全局资源。
lessons.evidence: Prior engineering incidents, generalized and scope-reviewed 2026-10-15. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md. This is not target-project runtime verification.

lessons.title: 框架缓存与失效 API 的历史限制
lessons.summary: 旧版本的缓存与路由失效限制，需对当前框架、部署模式和真实请求重新验证。
lessons.evidence: Legacy advice evaluated during import; exact old project data deliberately excluded. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md.

lessons.title: 部署 CLI 参数组合与 SDK 登录副作用
lessons.summary: 历史 CLI 参数及 SDK 凭据副作用只可作为排查线索。
lessons.evidence: Legacy advice evaluated during import; exact old project data deliberately excluded. See IMPORT_REVIEW.md.

lessons.title: 数据库驱动补丁与 ORM 命名限制
lessons.summary: 旧驱动补丁、ORM 嵌套命名和数据库标识限制不能整体照搬。

lessons.title: 记忆更新后自动提交和推送
lessons.summary: 不启用旧项目的自动上传记忆钩子。

lessons.title: 所有任务强制固定模型与无限审查
lessons.summary: 不继承固定模型、固定 effort、每轮全套构建和无限审查循环。
